title: The Fallout: Fulham 2-3 Chelsea | Planet FPL 2026/27
summary:
David and James cover all the key talking points from Chelsea's win at Fulham where Cole Palmer and Joao Pedro assisted each other and Morgan Rogers also found the net in The Blues 3-2 victory.

All the key moments covered as Robert Sanchez failed to keep out Josh King's goal and Gonzalo Garcia also found the scoresheet on debut. Should either have caught the eye for Fantasy managers? And how keen should managers be to add additions from that brilliant Chelsea trio? Cole Palmer in particular really impressed.

There's discussion on the tactics, good and bad from both, the stats and the selections, which included no Marco Palestra which will be a concern to Fantasy owners.

Plus, David gives additional views on Liverpool and Ipswich from the weekend and there's a look at current GW2 bus teams.

title: Who's Your Mama? | Planet FPL S. 10 Ep. 6 | GW1 Review | Fantasy Premier League
summary:
Manchester United were bad, Tottenham were worse, but Aston Villa said hold my beer last. And many popular FPL assets disappointed too with Erling Haaland and Bruno Fernandes among the players to blank.

But there were some success stories, which included for Suj as he hit a big Gameweek 1 score which featured hauls for Maxim De Cuyper and Mamadou Sanagare. But for James it was a bad outcome to the week.

All the games covered including tactical concerns raised about the Manchester clubs and Liverpool, great opening day win for Hull and Ipswich and how we can learn lessons from Gameweek 1 this season and last season.

Arsenal, Brentford, Brighton, Everton and Leeds and won to nil with largely settled teams under the same manager and they all have assets that appeal. But who does best in Gameweek 1, doesn't neccesarily do best in Gameweek 2.

This time last year Tijani Reijnders was a hot topic. For those who have had a difficult opening FPL weekend it may be time for calm reflection.

FPL points tough to come by this week, as Dominic Calvert-Lewin wipes out the Brighton clean sheet at the death and Thiago blanks for Brentford - so maybe we should've all just stuck with Watkins and Rogers. Elsewhere Liverpool and Chelsea play out a draw at Anfield, Brighton smash Wolves and Bournemouth continue their push for European football with a decent 0-1 away win at Fulham. We talk through our scores, rank updates and differentials for that final push in GWs 37-38.

title: Form vs Fixtures Experiment | Ep0 - The Rules | FPL Surgery
summary:
Since the Dawn of FPL managers have been fighting over Form vs Fixtures.

This is the start of a new series where we will try and answer this once and for all!

Dave and Rich will each start in GW1 with the EXACT same team. In this video they both agree on the team beforehand, and try and make it as template as possible to start the season (with the help of the FPL Surgery community). 

Rich will be playing as Team Fixtures and Dave will be playing as Team Form, and our objective is to outscore the other using ONLY transfers for either in form players, or players with decent fixtures.
